Full-Stack Engineer (TypeScript, AI features) at Brightwell Health

FICTIONAL job post for tests.

Brightwell builds patient intake software used by 90 clinics. We are a remote team of 18 and we are hiring a full-stack engineer to own features from the database to the browser.

What you will do
- Build product features end to end with React, Next.js and Node.js on PostgreSQL.
- Design authentication and role-based access control for clinic staff, doctors and patients.
- Add LLM features: call LLM APIs such as OpenAI or Gemini to summarize intake forms, with guardrails and evaluation.
- Write tests and keep CI green; review peers' pull requests.
- Work with design to ship accessible UI in Tailwind CSS.

Requirements
- 3+ years building web apps with TypeScript and React.
- Experience with auth (OAuth, Firebase Auth or similar) and role-based access control.
- Experience calling LLM APIs in production.
- Comfort with REST APIs and PostgreSQL.

Nice to have: Docker, GraphQL, internationalization (i18n).

Pay: $70,000 to $95,000 a year. Remote, UTC-2 to UTC+8.
